trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops last — it is not a separate task, it is the reward for finishing everything else on this list. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the map, the races and the robberies, with the 100% push saved for last. The platinum follows A Long Road immediately, so when the gold for 100% completion pops, so does this one.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The in-game checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) appears after the story, but progress made earlier counts and nothing on it is missable. It is the long grind: the story, every activity, every collectible and every challenge. Save it for last — it is usually the final trophy before the platinum, and Vice Got a Price! follows it immediately.
